projects.title: JIPLANCE
projects.description: A book-focused online store for Bangladesh, with fashion as a growing part of the brand. I work on the site's direction, shopping experience, and ongoing improvements.
projects.story:
The idea
Create a book-focused online store for customers in Bangladesh, with fashion as another part of the brand. Product categories and age guidance help visitors explore the collection.

The website
The shopping experience includes book and fashion sections, product pages, a wishlist, customer accounts, a cart and order tracking. The project uses Next.js, Supabase and Vercel.

My contribution
As the project owner, I shape the website’s direction, organise content and work on the shopping experience. I continue improving the site and its management features step by step.

What I’m learning
This project connects my interests in web development and entrepreneurship. It gives me practical experience in organising product information, thinking through customer journeys and maintaining a growing website.

projects.story:
The idea
Build a personal home on the web to introduce myself and bring my background, interests and work together.

My contribution
I created the portfolio, organised its content and published it with GitHub Pages. The project helped me practise presenting personal information in a clear, accessible way.

What I’m learning
Planning page sections, refining written content and publishing a live website gave me a foundation to build on. This earlier portfolio shows a step in my ongoing web-development journey.
